new_results.blocker_sorting_exchange: For every incomparable x,y and every extension A x M y B, stably sort M into D={z<y}, neutral N, U={x<z} and map to A D y N x U B; this is always a linear extension with reversed endpoint order.
new_results.exact_image: The image is exactly the reversed-order extensions whose open interval between y and x is neutral to both endpoints.
new_results.critical_surjectivity: The exchange is onto the entire reversed-order class iff ordered pair (x,y) is critical.
new_results.fiber_identity: With k(sigma)=fiber size and R=number of reversed-order targets outside the image, |Omega+|-2|Omega-|=sum(k-2)-2R; the 2/3 endpoint is exactly the corresponding excess-fiber charge inequality.
new_results.nested_chain_decomposition: For a nested deleted-chain profile I(v) subset I(u), there is an exact common-core lift bijection; the two complements are explicit lower/upper blocker-sandwich events.
new_results.source_valid_local_counterexample: Five-element width-three connected module-prime poset with covers 0<1,0<4,1<3,2<3; critical pair (2,4) has 8/11 vs 3/11 and exchange fibers 2,4,2 while its unique lower/upper blocker reversals each have mass 3/11. The poset still has other balanced pairs, so this refutes only the local factor-two closure, not POS3.
